evals.prompt: Remove google_fonts from this Flutter app and bundle the fonts so nothing downloads at runtime.
evals.expected_output: Runs scan.mjs, lists families and weights, tells the user what will be downloaded before fetching, runs fetch-fonts.mjs per family into assets/fonts, replaces GoogleFonts.<family>() calls with TextStyle(fontFamily: ...), removes the dependency and imports, adds the fonts: block and LICENSES.txt asset to pubspec, registers the license in main(), and ends with scan.mjs --verify exiting 0 and flutter analyze clean.

evals.prompt: Make our fonts work offline. The theme uses GoogleFonts.getFont(name) with a name from a config value.
evals.expected_output: Detects getFont in dynamicUsages and asks the user which families the name can take before downloading or editing anything, instead of guessing.

evals.prompt: Bundle Google Fonts into the app; the family we use only ships as a variable font.
evals.expected_output: fetch-fonts.mjs exits 2 asking for permission to install fonttools. The skill asks the user, and only then re-runs with --allow-install and gets static weight files.
